goal.en: Use the passive deliberately: when the action matters more than who did it.
goal.ar: أن تستخدم المبني للمجهول عن قصد: حين يكون الحدث أهم من فاعله.

text.en: am / is / are + past participle. The thing receiving the action becomes the subject: “The office is cleaned every evening.”
text.ar: التركيب: am/is/are مع التصريف الثالث. ويصبح المتلقي للفعل هو الفاعل النحوي: The office is cleaned every evening.

head: Active
Passive
rows: They make these shoes in Egypt.
These shoes are made in Egypt.
A team is testing the app.

text.en: The main verb must be the participle, not the base form: “is made”, never “is make”. And do not drop “be”: “The office cleaned every day” is wrong.
text.ar: الفعل الرئيسي يجب أن يكون التصريف الثالث لا المجرد: is made لا is make. ولا تحذف فعل الكون، فجملة The office cleaned every day خطأ.

text.en: was / were + past participle: “The bridge was built in 1998.” For questions, move “was/were” forward: “When was it built?”
text.ar: التركيب: was/were مع التصريف الثالث: The bridge was built in 1998. وفي السؤال يتقدّم was/were: When was it built?

items.en: My car was stolen last night.
The letters weren't sent on time.

text.en: Only the first verb changes tense. “The house was painted” — the participle never changes form.
text.ar: الزمن يظهر في الفعل الأول فقط، أما التصريف الثالث فلا يتغير أبداً.

text.en: The passive is a choice, not decoration. Use it when the doer is unknown, obvious, unimportant — or when you would rather not name them.
text.ar: المجهول اختيار لغرض لا زينة. نستخدمه حين يكون الفاعل مجهولاً أو بديهياً أو غير مهم، أو حين لا نريد ذكره.

head: Reason
Example
rows: The results will be published on Friday.

text.en: Name the doer with “by” only when it adds information: “The novel was written by a teenager.” Otherwise leave it out.
text.ar: نذكر الفاعل بـ by فقط حين يضيف معلومة مفيدة: The novel was written by a teenager. وإلا فالأفضل حذفه.

text.en: Do not use the passive everywhere to sound formal. An active sentence is usually clearer and shorter.
text.ar: لا تُكثر من المجهول ظناً أنه أرقى. فالجملة المبنية للمعلوم أوضح وأقصر في الغالب.

explanation.en: Plural subject + present passive: are + made.
explanation.ar: الفاعل جمع والزمن مضارع، فنستخدم are مع التصريف الثالث.

questions.sentence: English ___ in more than fifty countries.

explanation.en: English receives the action, and it is singular → is spoken.
explanation.ar: اللغة هنا متلقية للفعل وهي مفرد، فنقول is spoken.

options: The rooms are cleaned every morning.
The report is written by the team.
The shop is close at nine every day.
The bills are paid at the end of the month.

explanation.en: The passive needs the participle: the shop is closed at nine.
explanation.ar: المجهول يحتاج التصريف الثالث: the shop is closed at nine.

prompt.en: Make it passive: “Someone repairs the machines every week.”
prompt.ar: حوّلها إلى المجهول: Someone repairs the machines every week.

questions.answer: the machines are repaired every week

explanation.en: The object becomes the subject and “someone” disappears — that is the point of the passive.
explanation.ar: يصبح المفعول فاعلاً نحوياً ويختفي «someone»، وهذا هو الغرض من المجهول.

explanation.en: Singular subject, finished past → was + opened.
explanation.ar: الفاعل مفرد والزمن ماضٍ منتهٍ، فنستخدم was مع opened.

questions.sentence: The keys ___ anywhere in the building.

explanation.en: Plural subject in the past passive negative → weren't found.
explanation.ar: الفاعل جمع في الماضي المجهول المنفي، فنقول weren't found.

explanation.en: Question word + was + subject + past participle.
explanation.ar: أداة السؤال ثم was ثم الفاعل ثم التصريف الثالث.

prompt.en: Make it passive: “They cancelled the flight.”
prompt.ar: حوّلها إلى المجهول: They cancelled the flight.

explanation.en: was + cancelled. “They” is dropped because it adds nothing.
explanation.ar: was مع التصريف الثالث، ونحذف they لأنها لا تضيف شيئاً.

prompt.en: Why would a newspaper write “A decision was taken last night”?
prompt.ar: لماذا تكتب صحيفة A decision was taken last night؟

options: It avoids saying who took the decision.
It shows the decision was a good one.
It means the decision happened twice.
It proves the writer was present.

explanation.en: The passive lets the writer leave the doer out — useful, and sometimes evasive.
explanation.ar: المجهول يتيح للكاتب حذف الفاعل، وهو أسلوب مفيد وقد يكون تهرباً.

prompt.en: Which sentence is the better choice here?

options: My wallet was stolen on the bus yesterday.
Someone stole my wallet on the bus yesterday.
A thief has stolen my wallet on the bus.
My wallet, someone stole it on the bus.

explanation.en: The thief is unknown, so the passive puts the focus where it belongs — on the wallet. The second sentence is correct English but weaker here.
explanation.ar: السارق مجهول، فالمجهول يضع التركيز على المحفظة. والجملة الثانية صحيحة لكنها أضعف في هذا السياق.

questions.sentence: The song ___ a fifteen-year-old girl from Cairo.

explanation.en: Use “by” for the doer, and the participle “written”.
explanation.ar: نستخدم by للفاعل، والتصريف الثالث written.

prompt.en: In which sentence is the passive a poor choice?
prompt.ar: في أي جملة يكون المجهول اختياراً ضعيفاً؟

options: The ball was kicked by me into the garden.
The window was broken during the storm.
The results will be announced on Monday.
The building was damaged by the fire.

explanation.en: “By me” is clumsy — when you are the doer and it matters, use the active: “I kicked the ball into the garden.”
explanation.ar: عبارة by me ثقيلة. فإذا كنت أنت الفاعل وكان ذكره مهماً فاستخدم المعلوم: I kicked the ball.

questions.sentence: The road ___ at the moment, so use the other entrance.

explanation.en: An action in progress now, in the passive: is being + repaired.
explanation.ar: حدث جارٍ الآن في المجهول: is being مع التصريف الثالث.

prompt.en: Match the active sentence with its passive.

pairs: They are building a new road.
A new road is being built.
They build these cars in Japan.
These cars are built in Japan.
They have built a new wing.
A new wing has been built.

explanation.en: Only the “be” part carries the tense; the participle stays the same.
explanation.ar: الزمن يظهر في فعل الكون وحده، ويبقى التصريف الثالث كما هو.

prompt.en: Which sentence keeps the focus on the patient, not the hospital?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تُبقي التركيز على المريض لا على المستشفى؟

options: She was taken to hospital immediately.
They took her to the hospital at once.
The staff admitted her at once.

explanation.en: The passive puts “she” in the subject position, which is where English puts its topic.
explanation.ar: المجهول يضع «هي» في موضع الفاعل، وهو الموضع الذي تضع فيه الإنجليزية موضوع الجملة.
